page.title: Collaborators
page.subtitle: Teammates' Claudios, connected directly, read only

off.title: Work with your team
off.body: Your teammates' Claudios connect directly to yours and see, read only, the projects you choose to share: chats, memory and journal, documents and the board. Nobody can start work on another person's machine, so nobody spends anyone else's quota.

unavailable.load: The native module did not load
unavailable.body: Claudio works as before; Collaborators stays off on this install.

you.title: You
you.name: Display name
you.label: Install label
you.labelHint: Which of your installs this is, such as desktop or laptop
you.relayHint: A self-hosted iroh-relay, in place of n0's public relays. Leave it empty for the default ones.
you.byN0: Discovery and relays are run by n0
you.byN0Relay: Discovery is run by n0 · relay

connection.noRelay: No relay answered: only direct connections work

groups.title: Groups
groups.none: You are in no group yet
groups.noneHint: Create a group and invite your teammates, or paste an invite someone sent you.
groups.frozen: The owner's install is gone: the group can no longer change.
groups.conflict: Two versions {{version}} of the member list disagree. The owner's install settles it by signing the next one.
groups.removeWarn: Copies {{name}} already has stay on their machine.
groups.removeBody: Their Claudio stops receiving what this group shares.
groups.makeOwnerBody: {{name}} will sign every change to the group from now on, and you lose the right to change it: inviting, accepting, removing and transferring.
groups.leaveBody: Every copy synced through this group is deleted from this install, and your projects stop being shared with it.

pending.waiting: {{owner}} is offline. Your request has been left with {{member}} (<id>{{memberId}}</id>) and will be accepted when {{owner}} is back.

invite.title: Invite to {{group}}
invite.qr: QR code of the invite to {{group}}
invite.presence: If you are offline when they join, they wait until you are back.
invite.standing: Keep a copy of this group on another install, or transfer ownership before changing machines: if this install is lost, the group can no longer change.
invite.tooLong: This invite is too long for a QR code. Copy the text instead.

join.title: Join a group
join.pasteHint: Paste the invite a group's owner sent you.

create.title: Create a group
create.name: Name
create.hint: You become its owner: you invite, accept and remove members.

sharedWithYou.title: Shared with you
sharedWithYou.noneHint: When a teammate shares a project with one of your groups, it shows here.
sharedWithYou.linkHint: The shared project then shows in the Shared tab of the project you choose.

sharing.title: Sharing
sharing.off: Turn on Collaborators to share this project with your team, read only.
sharing.unavailable: Collaborators is not available on this install.
sharing.noGroups: You are in no group yet. Create or join one in Collaborators to share this project.
sharing.warning: Everything in this project's chats is sent as it is, including command output. Each collaborator's Claudio deletes its copy when you stop sharing, but what a person has already received or copied elsewhere cannot be taken back.
sharing.keyRule: Use 3 to 200 lower-case letters, digits and . _ / # -
sharing.noRemote: No git remote: shared by its own id
sharing.keyInUse: {{project}} already shares this key. Edit the key to share this project too.
sharing.agentsMayReadHint: Off, a teammate's assistant and chats do not get this project; the teammate still reads it in their Shared tab.
sharing.agentReads: Agents in this project can read what teammates share here
sharing.agentReadsHint: Only chats that ask before running a command get the read tools: never one in Skip permission checks, and never an orchestration's workers. What they read is listed in Settings → Access & safety.

shared.gone: Nobody shares this project with you now
shared.nothing: {{name}} shares nothing you can read here yet
shared.workingCopy: Working copy on {{name}}'s machine · may differ from your checkout

empty.chats: {{name}} has no chats in this project yet
empty.memory: No memory files in this project yet
empty.documents: No documents in this project yet
empty.board: No tasks on this board yet
empty.journal: No journal entries in this project yet
empty.artifacts: No artifacts in this project yet

readOnly.title: Shared project
readOnly.hint: Read from the copy this install holds. Link it to a local project to read it in that project's Shared tab.
readOnly.hintLinked: Linked to {{project}}: it is also read in that project's Shared tab.
readOnly.gone: This project is no longer shared with you
readOnly.goneHint: Its owner stopped sharing it, or you are no longer in a group with them.

agents.title: Agents
agents.assistant: The assistant reads what is shared with you
agents.hint: The assistant runs no command, so it can answer questions about what teammates share. A project's chats read only when the project allows it in its Sharing section, and never in chats that run commands without asking. A teammate's text is shown to them as third-party content, never as instructions.

agentReads.forbidden: The sharer does not let agents read this

chip.label: Reads teammates' shares
chip.assistant: This chat can read everything teammates share with you, unless a sharer forbids it
chip.project: This chat can read what teammates share into its project, unless a sharer forbids it

audit.title: Read by agents
audit.intro: Every read a chat's agent made of what teammates share with you, newest first. Uploads are never handed to an agent.
audit.none: No agent has read what teammates share
audit.noneHint: The assistant and the chats of projects that allow it will show up here once they read a teammate's share.
